scope: F01-F08 executable code findings; F09/F10 remain product work

platform.note: Python 3.14 and the non-writable system TEMP produce unrelated asyncio/JFR/gopls failures; the final run uses 3.11.9 and a writable TEMP/TMP.

F01_mcp_tool_surface.implementation: tools/list is generated from the implemented handler registry; inspect advertises only implemented kinds; archmeld_capabilities reports contract tools as requires_grant or not_implemented
tests: crates/archmeld-api/tests/mcp_stdio.rs: tools.len()==5, all advertised tools implemented, write tools absent, capabilities statuses
crates/archmeld-api/tests/security_mcp.rs: no exec/network tool, all advertised tools implemented

F02_context_anchor.implementation: core::anchor::byte_range resolves byte and one-based line anchors for ContextPack and source API; ContextPack reports the resolved byte range
tests: crates/archmeld-core/tests/context_pack.rs: target function at line 262 with CRLF/CJK/no trailing newline returns the target body, not the header

F03_snapshot_first_index.implementation: capture snapshot, materialize every captured file from CAS, parse the materialization, import against the same captured file digests, remove the copy
tests: crates/archmeld-api/src/cli.rs index_tests: fake helper mutates the live file while parsing; published entity and source still match the captured bytes
real packaged helper run: 2 files -> 4 entities / 3 relations, analysis.removed=true

F04_source_search.implementation: kind=source performs literal, case-sensitive, snapshot-bound byte search with path/line/column/byte range/text/entity_ids and a resumable cursor
F04_source_search.limits: 256 MiB scan budget; non-UTF-8 files skipped and coverage partial; no tokenizer/FTS/embeddings
F04_source_search.tests: crates/archmeld-core/tests/source_search.rs: body text at line >220, entity mapping, three-page cursor union of five matches, live edit does not change the old snapshot result

F05_context_relevance.implementation: objective tokens seed name/source matches plus a bounded one-hop relation neighborhood; relevant claims are ranked, unrelated claims aggregated as omissions; cursor is bound to snapshot+request and continues the deterministic candidate order
F05_context_relevance.limits: heuristic name/source/one-hop relevance, not a semantic model; tiny budgets may trim optional relevance/page metadata explicitly
F05_context_relevance.tests: crates/archmeld-core/tests/context_relevance.rs: objective picks target_widget first, 30 unrelated rejected claims do not crowd it out, 1024-token cursor pages equal the 64000-token selection, unmatched objective reports fallback

F06_edge_cap.implementation: relation scan requests cap+1, truncates at cap, marks coverage partial, records unresolved_count and a limitation/warning
F06_edge_cap.tests: crates/archmeld-core/src/query.rs production test inserts 200001 relations and calls traverse with the real HARD_EDGE_CAP; asserts edge_scan_truncated, boundary_edges_truncated, coverage=partial and unresolved_count=1 (36.36s). A reduced-cap test remains for the fast branch.

F07_page_boundary_edges.implementation: each traversal page reports boundary_edges and deduplicated boundary_entities with missing-endpoint stubs; merging by relation id reconstructs incident edges
F07_page_boundary_edges.tests: crates/archmeld-core/tests/query_pagination.rs: A->B->C, max_nodes=2; B->C appears on both pages and survives the union

F08_scenario_lock.implementation: scenario prepare (Store) / execute (no Store, spawn_blocking) / finalize (Store); independent cancellation registry and POST /v1/scenarios/{run_id}/cancel
F08_scenario_lock.tests: crates/archmeld-api/tests/scenario_http.rs: during a 10-second scenario, a query and a cancel both return in under 2 seconds; run completion is cancelled
F08_scenario_lock.limit: cancellation is cooperative and in-memory; it is not persisted across a server restart

F10_status_entry.implementation: archmeld status and GET /v1/status report projects, latest snapshot, counts, languages, actions and optional read-only workspace freshness. archmeld review-diff and POST /v1/reviews/workspace-diff report line changes, base/current digests, base-anchor entities, static relation impact, trigger, confidence and verification=not_run. archmeld refresh creates a new snapshot and reports the exact snapshot-to-snapshot delta while retaining the old snapshot. The extension can discover project/snapshot through /v1/status. MCP exposes read-only archmeld_status and archmeld_review using only the project's registered active workspace root.
tests: crates/archmeld-core/tests/diff_review.rs: workspace review and exact snapshot diff
crates/archmeld-api/src/cli.rs tests: review-diff CLI, refresh new snapshot + old retained, fake-helper refresh
crates/archmeld-api/tests/scenario_http.rs: GET /v1/status, POST /v1/reviews/workspace-diff, unknown workspace handle refused

the comparative agent-without-ARCHMELD benchmark was not run

F09_module_projection.implementation: Modules view groups by first path segment; Responsibilities view groups by a selected candidate architecture's real member_entity_ids. Both use dependency-depth layers, persist manual drag positions per project/snapshot/view, retain relation_ids/kinds/evidence_ids on aggregate edges, and support member drill-down plus underlying-edge inspection. Runtime filter keeps entities mapped by /v1/runtime spans and projects parent/child span pairs as observed_span_parent containment edges labelled span parent; other edges are static adjacency.
tests: archmeld-vscode/test/model.test.js: module/component grouping, topology positions, manual overrides, aggregate evidence/relation ids, drill-down, runtime filter
archmeld-vscode/test/webview.test.js: Modules button, Cytoscape dragfree/moveNode handlers
residuals: span-parent containment is not confirmed call semantics
responsibility projection requires an explicitly selected candidate architecture

limitations: This is a project-test-phase closure, not a release-level or R1 claim.
Context relevance and source search are deterministic heuristics, not semantic/vector retrieval.
Differential line-overlap review is static text evidence; it does not execute builds/tests and does not infer new calls.
Responsibility components come from an explicitly selected candidate architecture and are never treated as accepted architecture.
MCP status/review use only the registered active workspace root; they do not accept caller-supplied paths.
Runtime span-parent edges are containment evidence from real spans; they are not confirmed calls and do not imply runtime order.
The 200001-edge test verifies truncation/partial semantics, not query throughput or memory as a benchmark.
